title: [review] deaddrop_get node= is a non-NUL-terminated pointer into option buffer passed as const char*
description: P2 latent (no provider registered in-tree today). coap_dtn.c:173-181 extracts node= as qopts[i].value+5 pointer into the CoAP option buffer and passes to s_provider->retrieve(buf, sizeof(buf), node) whose API contract (coap_dtn.h:54) invites strlen/strcmp -> reads past option into packet buffer. Fix: copy into NUL-terminated bounded local (char node[32]; n=MIN(len-5,sizeof-1)) before use; document the copy contract in coap_dtn.h.
close_reason: Fixed deaddrop node query handling by copying into a bounded NUL-terminated buffer and documented the provider contract. Path-scoped diff check passed.
